title: Outdoor Air-Quality (Wildfire Smoke) Watch
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers.
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=purpleair:aqi
| timechart span=1h avg(aqi) as aqi
| eval category=case(aqi<=50,"good",aqi<=100,"moderate",aqi<=150,"unhealthy for sensitive",1=1,"unhealthy")
| where aqi>100
description: Trends the outdoor air-quality index from a nearby sensor and alerts when smoke or pollution makes it unsafe to open windows or exercise outside.
value: During wildfire season a local sensor beats a distant official station; a timely alert protects your lungs and tells you when to close up.
implementation: Ingest a local outdoor air-quality feed; schedule hourly and alert when the index becomes unhealthy.
visualization: Line chart of hourly outdoor air-quality index with category bands.
grandmaExplanation: It watches the outdoor air near your home and warns you when smoke or pollution makes it unhealthy to go outside.
